The '''main boulevard of Eusebus''' was a thoroughfare in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]] on [[Euceron]]. The boulevard connected to [[Usirine Street]] and [[Air Transit Green]], by which one could reach [[Stadium One]] and [[Stadium Ten]], respectively.<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
